All 13 tests pass. Done:

**`src/urlkit.ts`** — two exported functions:
- `joinQuery(base, params)` — sorts keys, URL-encodes, omits `false` values, adds `?` only when needed, extends existing queries with `&`
- `parseQuery(url)` — extracts and decodes the query string into `Record<string, string>`

**`tests/urlkit.test.ts`** — 13 test cases (exceeds the minimum 8) covering all required scenarios:
- empty params, false-value omission, key sorting, URL encoding of spaces/ampersands, existing query extension, parse round-trip, numeric serialization, boolean serialization
